client_apparel_apex.name: Apex Streetwear Co.
client_apparel_apex.details: Premium US streetwear brand based in LA. Heavyweight hoodies, oversized graphic tees, and cargo pants. Free express shipping on US orders over $75.
client_apparel_apex.faqs: Q: How do your hoodies fit? A: They feature an intentional relaxed/oversized fit. If you prefer a tailored fit, size down!
client_apparel_apex.salesGoal: Resolve sizing hesitation, highlight shipping perks ($75+ free shipping), and guide shoppers to checkout.
